site.name: Agenzia delle Entrate - Fatture e Corrispettivi

process.name: Request active or passive invoices and retrieve ZIP
process.objective: Select the authorized taxpayer profile, request a bounded invoice population, and retrieve the completed ZIP when available.
out_of_scope: Authentication or delegated-authority decisions by the model
Any payment, filing, signature, or submission outside the declared download request

inputs.name: invoice-direction
inputs.purpose: Choose active invoices, passive invoices, or the supported combined scope.

inputs.name: date-from
inputs.purpose: Start of the authorized invoice period.

inputs.name: date-to
inputs.purpose: End of the authorized invoice period.

outputs.name: invoice-zip
outputs.content: ZIP returned by the portal for the declared request; business bytes remain outside the capability.

outputs.name: run-summary
outputs.content: Milestone and download-event evidence without taxpayer or invoice content.

milestones.intent: Resume after the operator has authenticated and selected the correct taxpayer or delegated profile.
preconditions: The operator is authorized for the selected profile.
No authentication or secret-entry screen is visible.
recovery: Run authorized live discovery; do not infer profile controls from this scaffold.

milestones.intent: Enter the declared direction and period and create the bounded export request.
preconditions: The requested scope and dates have been confirmed.
Live discovery has identified the real controls and whether request creation is consequential.
recovery: Discover active and passive branches separately when the portal exposes different journeys.
Confirm at action time before creating a portal request if the action has an external side effect.

milestones.intent: Find the completed request and download the ZIP through the browser download event.
preconditions: The request is complete or the delayed retrieval branch has been reached.
recovery: Model delayed availability as a separate resumable branch during live discovery.
Keep downloaded invoice bytes outside discovery and capability artifacts.

evidence_to_record: Authorized post-login profile state was verified.
The bounded request reached its portal-defined completion state.
The browser emitted the expected ZIP download event.

model_data: Visible post-login page content needed to interpret the selected invoice process
DOM and accessibility metadata for controls within the allowed origin
Declared runtime inputs and generic download-event metadata

known_limits: No successful authenticated live discovery is currently available in repository evidence.
Real controls, portal branches, additional origins, request completion timing, and download evidence remain unknown.
